sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Tahquamenon Falls resources via /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/maps, map 'Rivermouth Pines')

values.note: DNR rate table, Rivermouth Pines Semi-Modern/Rustic: $36 a night semi-modern (water spigots on, roughly mid-May to mid-October), $20 rustic otherwise. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Tahquamenon Falls / Rivermouth Pines Semi-Modern/Rustic: semi-modern $36, rustic $20; 'Semi-modern campsites do not have electricity'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates ('Semi-modern campsites do not have electricity') + midnrreservations.com map 'Rivermouth Pines' (35 campsites 'Electrical Service: Not Available'; only the camper cabin has power), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 35 campsites plus a camper cabin (DNR counts 36). Booking site: 7 sites take trailers/RVs up to 50 ft, 18 up to 30 ft, 1 up to 25 ft, 9 only to 20 ft; no pull-throughs. Several are riverfront. DNR: 'sandy surface ideal for tent, van or compact campers.'

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Rivermouth Rustic Campground: 'Number of sites: 36', 'ideal for tent, van or compact campers') + midnrreservations.com resources (allowed equipment per site, 'Pull Through: No', 'Riverfront' descriptions), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water spigots generally run mid-May through the second Sunday in October; in season campers may use the restrooms and showers at Rivermouth Modern, about a 10-minute walk. Out of season the campground is rustic and water must be brought in.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Rivermouth Rustic Campground: 'water spigots are generally available mid-May through the second Sunday in October', 'vault toilets located throughout the campground', 'A sanitation station and recycling are available'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: midnrreservations.com map 'Rivermouth Pines' (35 reservable campsites) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls, read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed fees $20 (rustic) to $36 (semi-modern) with the Recreation Passport requirement noted; season Apr 15-Nov 29 already manual. Added no electric, 35 campsites (7 take RVs to 50 ft, 18 to 30 ft; no pull-throughs), vault toilets, seasonal water spigots, sanitation station, reservable. The DNR park page calls this campground 'Tahquamenon Falls Rivermouth Rustic Campground'; the rate table and booking site call it 'Rivermouth Pines'. AWH note kept as is (consistent with 'compact campers').
flags: Website: the entry's website is the bare reservation home page https://midnrreservations.com/; the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Rivermouth Rustic Campground section).
Phone: the entry has none; the park office is 906-492-3415 (DNR park page).

Size: DNR describes the sites as 'ideal for tent, van or compact campers' and 9 of 35 sites take only 20-ft units, but 26 allow RVs of 25 ft or more (7 up to 50 ft), so a 23-ft motorhome fits at most sites.
